mapper.insert: INSERT INTO slot_site (course_site_id, site_id, track, sort_no, route_note, is_star, serving_note) VALUES (#{courseSiteId}, #{siteId}, #{track}, #{sortNo}, #{routeNote}, #{isStar}, #{servingNote}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sort_no = VALUES(sort_no), route_note = VALUES(route_note), is_star = VALUES(is_star), serving_note = VALUES(serving_note)
mapper.select: SELECT course_site_id FROM slot_site WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND track = #{track} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM slot_site WHERE course_site_id = #{courseSiteId} AND site_id = #{siteId}

SELECT ss.course_site_id AS courseSiteId, ss.site_id AS siteId, COALESCE(si.name, s.name) AS siteName, ss.track AS track, ss.sort_no AS sortNo, ss.route_note AS routeNote, ss.is_star AS isStar, ss.serving_note AS servingNote, ss.is_congested AS congested, s.status AS siteStatus FROM slot_site ss JOIN course_site cs ON cs.course_site_id = ss.course_site_id AND cs.course_id = #{courseId} JOIN site s ON s.site_id = ss.site_id LEFT JOIN site_i18n si ON si.site_id = s.site_id AND si.locale = #{locale} WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY cs.position, ss.track, ss.sort_no
mapper.update: UPDATE slot_site SET is_congested = 1 WHERE site_id = #{siteId}
